text: Inflation jumping to 3.7% with the Fed expected to hike in December means borrowing costs are heading higher — this is a hostile environment for unprofitable and high-valuation stocks, so tighten risk across the board.
Sell RGTI now — down 54% with shrinking revenue, negative earnings, and over 21% short interest, this is a broken position with no fundamental support to justify holding.
Sell QBTS immediately — down 58.5% is the worst loss in your portfolio, and like RGTI the quantum computing thesis has completely failed to deliver results.
Sell BMNR — down 55% from its high with negative free cash flow and high short interest, this stock is burning cash and showing no signs of recovery.
Trim MSTR — it's a leveraged Bitcoin bet sitting 48% off its high with terrible technicals, and rising rates make this kind of speculative position especially dangerous.
Add to ADBE on this pullback — a PE of 8.7 with double-digit revenue and free cash flow growth makes it genuinely cheap, and profitable cash-generating businesses hold up best when rates are rising.
Add to GOOGL — while a 28% drawdown stings, 15% revenue growth and strong fundamentals at a discounted price make this a solid opportunity to build a position in a quality name.
